purpose: Prevent a partial recollection or evidence window from being misrepresented as total project duration or reduced ownership in career artifacts.

runtime_evidence_contract.scope: One evaluated claim or paragraph at a time. The supplied source record must come from current reviewed user data.
runtime_evidence_contract.validation: Reject duration statements without source-verified total duration, and reject temporary-cover framing that contradicts owner-scope evidence.
runtime_evidence_contract.user_private_inputs: Untracked, local or connected only; never a tracked fixture.

proof_ceiling: Contract and synthetic tests guard known linguistic regressions; they do not certify arbitrary semantic truth, current private-source connectivity, real résumé content, PDF freshness, browser autofill, or submission.
